sources.content:
Industrial spinning of recombinant spider silk

Fiber spinning, not expression titer, is the usual bottleneck in scale-up. Drawing stress depends on diameter and take-up speed under controlled humidity.
Spider silk is a protein fiber produced by spiders. Tensile strength is often reported near 1-2 GPa in laboratory literature.
